name: ProtacDB_search_protacs
description: Search PROTAC-DB 3.0 for PROTAC (Proteolysis Targeting Chimera) compounds. Filter by target protein and/or E3 ligase. Returns PROTAC structures with DC50, Dmax, SMILES, cell line, and pharmacological data. At least one of target or e3_ligase is required. Use for: finding PROTACs targeting BRD4, KRAS, AR; comparing CRBN vs VHL-based PROTACs.

target.description: Target protein name or gene symbol (e.g., 'BRD4', 'KRAS', 'AR', 'BCL2'). At least one of target or e3_ligase required.

e3_ligase.description: E3 ubiquitin ligase (e.g., 'CRBN', 'VHL', 'MDM2', 'XIAP'). At least one of target or e3_ligase required.

max_results.description: Maximum number of compounds to return (default 50, max 100)

id_in_database.description: ProtacDB's own identifier for the compound.

common_name.description: The PROTAC's published name, where it has one.

smiles_canonical.description: Canonical SMILES of the whole bifunctional molecule -- warhead, linker and E3 ligand together.

e3_ligase.description: The E3 ligase the PROTAC recruits, e.g. 'VHL', 'CRBN'. Determines which tissues can degrade the target at all, since ligase expression varies.

pdb.description: PDB entry for the ternary complex, where one was solved.

predicted_structure.description: A modelled ternary-complex structure, where no experimental one exists. Not experimental evidence.

paper.description: The publication the data came from.

dc50.description: DC50: the concentration that degrades half the target. The primary potency measure for a degrader -- and not an IC50, because degradation is catalytic. ProtacDB stores each measured value beside the ASSAY it came from, in a matching `assay_*` column. Two values of the same quantity from different assays are not comparable, so the value must never be read without its assay.

dmax.description: Dmax: the MAXIMUM degradation achieved, as a percentage. A PROTAC with a good DC50 and a Dmax of 40% leaves most of the target standing, so DC50 alone overstates it.

percent_degradation.description: Degradation at a stated concentration, where the paper reported a single point rather than a curve.

percent_degradation_assay.description: The assay and conditions behind that percentage.

wb_data.description: The Western blot readout the degradation was measured from.

wb_data_assay.description: Description of that blot, e.g. 'WB analysis of BRD9 and BRD7 in HeLa cells'. Names which proteins were actually probed.

assay_protac.description: The assay used for the PROTAC itself.

ic50.description: IC50 of the compound. ProtacDB stores each measured value beside the ASSAY it came from, in a matching `assay_*` column. Two values of the same quantity from different assays are not comparable, so the value must never be read without its assay.

ic50_assay.description: The assay that IC50 was measured in.

ec50.description: EC50 of the compound. ProtacDB stores each measured value beside the ASSAY it came from, in a matching `assay_*` column. Two values of the same quantity from different assays are not comparable, so the value must never be read without its assay.

ec50_assay.description: The assay that EC50 was measured in.

gi50.description: GI50: the concentration halving cell growth.

gi50_assay.description: The assay and cell line behind it. A GI50 without its cell line says nothing.

ic50_ce.description: IC50 measured against the ternary COMPLEX. Cooperativity is the ratio between the complex value and the binary ones, so all three are needed to say whether the PROTAC binds better as a complex than as its parts.

assay_ic50_ce.description: The assay that ic50_ce was measured in, e.g. 'ITC', 'ITC/FP'.

ic50_pe.description: IC50 measured against the E3 ligase end alone. Cooperativity is the ratio between the complex value and the binary ones, so all three are needed to say whether the PROTAC binds better as a complex than as its parts.

assay_ic50_pe.description: The assay that ic50_pe was measured in, e.g. 'ITC', 'ITC/FP'.

ic50_pt.description: IC50 measured against the target end alone. Cooperativity is the ratio between the complex value and the binary ones, so all three are needed to say whether the PROTAC binds better as a complex than as its parts.

assay_ic50_pt.description: The assay that ic50_pt was measured in, e.g. 'ITC', 'ITC/FP'.

kd_ce.description: binding affinity measured against the ternary COMPLEX. Cooperativity is the ratio between the complex value and the binary ones, so all three are needed to say whether the PROTAC binds better as a complex than as its parts.

assay_kd_ce.description: The assay that kd_ce was measured in, e.g. 'ITC', 'ITC/FP'.

kd_pe.description: binding affinity measured against the E3 ligase end alone. Cooperativity is the ratio between the complex value and the binary ones, so all three are needed to say whether the PROTAC binds better as a complex than as its parts.

assay_kd_pe.description: The assay that kd_pe was measured in, e.g. 'ITC', 'ITC/FP'.

kd_pt.description: binding affinity measured against the target end alone. Cooperativity is the ratio between the complex value and the binary ones, so all three are needed to say whether the PROTAC binds better as a complex than as its parts.

assay_kd_pt.description: The assay that kd_pt was measured in, e.g. 'ITC', 'ITC/FP'.

name: ProtacDB_get_protac
description: Get detailed information about a specific PROTAC compound by its PROTAC-DB ID. Returns full record including SMILES structure, warhead canonical SMILES, linker, E3 ligand, target protein, DC50 values, Dmax, cell lines tested, and literature references (DOI, journal).

e3_ligase.description: The E3 ligase the PROTAC recruits, e.g. 'VHL', 'CRBN'. Determines which tissues can degrade the target at all, since ligase expression varies.

e3_ligand_canonical.description: SMILES of the E3-binding end alone.

warhead_canonical.description: SMILES of the target-binding end alone.

linker_canonical.description: SMILES of the linker. Linker length and composition are the usual determinant of whether a ternary complex forms.

gi50.description: GI50: the concentration halving cell growth.

bioavailability.description: Oral bioavailability as a percentage. PROTACs are large and usually poorly bioavailable, so a null here is the common case, not an oversight.

caco2_a2b.description: Caco-2 permeability, apical to basolateral -- absorption.

caco2_b2a.description: Caco-2 permeability, basolateral to apical. A b2a far above a2b means active efflux, which no amount of dosing overcomes.

cl_f.description: Apparent clearance after oral dosing, CL/F -- clearance divided by bioavailability, so it is not clearance.

auc_0_t.description: Area under the curve to the last measured point.

auc_0_infinity.description: Area under the curve extrapolated to infinity. Larger than auc_0_t by the extrapolated tail, which is an estimate.

assay_kon_ce.description: The assay that kon_ce was measured in, e.g. 'ITC', 'ITC/FP'.

kon_pe.description: association rate measured against the E3 ligase end alone. Cooperativity is the ratio between the complex value and the binary ones, so all three are needed to say whether the PROTAC binds better as a complex than as its parts.

kon_pt.description: association rate measured against the target end alone. Cooperativity is the ratio between the complex value and the binary ones, so all three are needed to say whether the PROTAC binds better as a complex than as its parts.

inchikey.description: InChIKey -- the hashed form, and the right key for matching against another database.

molwt.description: Average molecular weight. PROTACs sit far outside Lipinski space, so a weight near 1000 is normal here and is not a red flag by itself.

numrotatablebonds.description: Rotatable bonds. The linker dominates this, and it is what the entropic cost of forming a ternary complex is paid on.

tpsa.description: Topological polar surface area. Above ~140 passive permeability is usually poor, and most PROTACs are well above it.

target.description: The degraded target, as ProtacDB names it.

id_warhead.description: ProtacDB id of the warhead component, for finding other PROTACs built on the same binder.

id_e3_ligand.description: ProtacDB id of the E3 ligand.

id_in_wb.description: Id of the Western blot record the degradation data came from.

wb_figure.description: Which figure of the paper the blot is.

permeability_ref.description: Reference for the permeability data, which often comes from a different paper than the potency.

ed50.description: ED50, the dose producing half the maximal effect in vivo.

ed50_assay.description: The in vivo model it was measured in.

gr50.description: GR50, the growth-rate-corrected analogue of GI50. Unlike GI50 it does not depend on how fast the cell line divides, so it compares across lines where GI50 cannot.

gr50_assay.description: The assay and cell line behind it.

mrt_0_t.description: Mean residence time to the last measured point.

mrt_0_infinity.description: Mean residence time extrapolated to infinity.

vss.description: Volume of distribution at steady state.

vz.description: Volume of distribution in the terminal phase.

vz_f.description: That volume divided by bioavailability -- not a volume, and not comparable with vz.

koff_ce.description: Dissociation rate constant against the ternary COMPLEX. The residence time of the ternary complex is what the degradation actually depends on, more than its affinity.

h_ce.description: Binding enthalpy against the ternary COMPLEX, from calorimetry.

ts_ce.description: The entropic term -TdS against the ternary COMPLEX. Enthalpy and entropy sum to the free energy, so a favourable dG can hide an unfavourable entropy the linker is paying for.

t_ce.description: Temperature the measurement against the ternary COMPLEX was made at. Thermodynamic terms are only comparable at the same temperature.

koff_pe.description: Dissociation rate constant against the E3 ligase end alone. The residence time of the ternary complex is what the degradation actually depends on, more than its affinity.

h_pe.description: Binding enthalpy against the E3 ligase end alone, from calorimetry.

ts_pe.description: The entropic term -TdS against the E3 ligase end alone. Enthalpy and entropy sum to the free energy, so a favourable dG can hide an unfavourable entropy the linker is paying for.

t_pe.description: Temperature the measurement against the E3 ligase end alone was made at. Thermodynamic terms are only comparable at the same temperature.

koff_pt.description: Dissociation rate constant against the target end alone. The residence time of the ternary complex is what the degradation actually depends on, more than its affinity.

h_pt.description: Binding enthalpy against the target end alone, from calorimetry.

name: ProtacDB_search_targets
description: Search PROTAC target proteins in PROTAC-DB 3.0. Returns target protein names (short and long). Over 446 unique targets available. Use for: discovering what proteins can be targeted by PROTACs, finding targets by gene symbol or protein name.

target_name.description: Target protein name or gene symbol (e.g., 'BRD4', 'KRAS'). Returns all targets if omitted.

uniprot_id.description: UniProt accession ID (e.g., 'O60885' for BRD4). Mutually exclusive with target_name.

short_target_name_2.description: A second target where the PROTAC degrades more than one. Its presence is the selectivity problem stated outright.
